history.title: Release history and rollback
history.description: The last five releases. Pick one to preview exactly what returning to it would do. Nothing is applied from this page: a rollback is run on the server so the control plane never replaces itself.
history.empty: No releases found for this channel.
history.emptyHint: Switch to another channel above, or check that this host can reach github.com.
history.githubUnreachable: GitHub could not be reached. Showing cached releases and the binaries kept on this host.
history.currentSchemaUnknown: Database schema version could not be read

plan.title: Rollback to {{version}}
plan.description: A read-only preview. Nothing has changed.
plan.loading: Checking this release against your database...
plan.loadError: Could not build the rollback plan: {{message}}
plan.targetUnknown: {{version}} does not publish a schema version.
plan.downtime: Estimated downtime: about {{seconds}} seconds while the service restarts.
plan.blocked: Blocked: fix the failing checks below before rolling back.
plan.changesTitle: What you give up between {{target}} and {{current}}
plan.noChanges: No release notes are available for the releases in between.

verdict.binary_only: Safe: the database schema matches, so only the program is replaced. Your data is untouched.
verdict.forward: This release is newer than your database and will migrate it forward when it starts. That is an upgrade, not a rollback.
verdict.restore_required: A binary-only rollback is not possible. This release is older than your database schema and would refuse to start. The only way back is to restore a database backup, which permanently loses everything written after it.
verdict.unknown: This release does not publish its database schema version, so compatibility cannot be confirmed. An older program refuses to start on a newer schema without touching data, and the previous release is restored automatically if that happens.

step.backup: Take a fresh backup of the control plane database
step.fetch: Download the release and verify its checksum and signature
step.verify: Re-check the retained binary against its recorded checksum
step.stop: Stop the control plane (apps keep running)
step.restore_backup: Replace the database with the backup you choose
step.verify_health: Wait for health and readiness checks to pass
step.auto_recover: If it does not become healthy, put the previous release back automatically

warning.data_loss: Data written after the chosen backup is lost for good.
warning.forward_migration: The database will be migrated forward.
warning.no_compatible_backup: No local backup is old enough for this release, so a rollback to it is not possible from here.
warning.dev_build: This is a development build, so the running binary cannot be kept for rollback.

dataLoss.title: This loses data
dataLoss.body: Restoring replaces the database with a backup. Anything written after the backup is lost, including deploys, settings changes and audit entries. The database you have now is kept beside it as a copy, and a fresh backup is taken first.
dataLoss.noneCompatible: No backup on this host is compatible with {{version}}.

commands.fetch: 1. Stage the verified release on the server
commands.apply: 2. Roll back on the server (you will be asked to type {{version}})
commands.restore: Roll back and restore the backup on the server

plan.backupHint: Backups older than a day are flagged above. A fresh backup is also taken automatically before anything changes.

verify.title: Verify after an upgrade or rollback
verify.description: Runs the control plane's own health checks and reports a clear result. Run it once the service is back.

upgradeHistory.title: Upgrade history
upgradeHistory.description: Every version this control plane has run, recorded when it started, however it was installed. Nothing upgrades silently: acknowledge each change once you have seen it.
upgradeHistory.empty: No upgrades recorded yet: the first one will appear here.
upgradeHistory.emptyHint: A new row is added whenever the control plane starts on a different version.
upgradeHistory.pendingBody: These version changes have not been acknowledged by anyone yet. Check what changed, then acknowledge each one.
upgradeHistory.unacknowledged: Not acknowledged yet. Someone should confirm this change was expected.
upgradeHistory.initiatorUnknown: Initiator unknown: nothing recorded who changed the version (no installer note was left).
upgradeHistory.schemaMoved: The database schema changed. Returning to the previous version needs a database restore, which loses data written since.
upgradeHistory.notesUnavailable: Release notes were not available at the time
